import java.util.Scanner;

public class GeneticEngineering {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = sc.nextLine();
        sc.close();

        int res = 0;
        int n = str.length();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ) {
            int count = 1;
            int j = i + 1;
            
            while (j < n && str.charAt(j) == str.charAt(i)) {
                count++;
                j++;
            }
            
            if (count % 2 == 0) {
                res++;
            }
            
            i = j;
        }
        
        System.out.print(res);
    }
}
